scope: sector opening-angle redesign and real fastener detail (rev.4b)

F1_lobe_heave_claim_wrong.reality: heave = R_tread - r_lobe_tip*cos(opening/2); at the SAME opening the ramp roughly doubles heave
F1_lobe_heave_claim_wrong.conclusion: 75.6 -> 18.56 was the effect of shrinking the opening 135 -> 45, not the lobe. The lobe's real value is edge-impact smoothing and a pointed stair-hooking tip.

F2_degenerate_optimum.problem: heave was minimised with no lower bound on the opening angle, so the optimum walked toward a full wheel
F2_degenerate_optimum.fix: three explicit constraints written into 2.35: tread arc >= 180 deg, rolling tilt, throat width

F3_hard_geometric_wall.rule: with diagonal 180-degree phasing the body heave is exactly zero iff tread arc >= 180 deg
F3_hard_geometric_wall.consequence: with 45-degree lobes the opening cannot exceed 90 deg

F4_no_fastener_detail.was: hub deliberately solid, no holes anywhere, I02 BLOCKED
F4_no_fastener_detail.now: horn spigot, 8x M2 insert pilots on PCD 16, bearing seat, stub relief, 6 web lightening holes
